coverageNotes: SCOPE AND METHOD. Energy, pharma/healthcare, retail, consumer-goods and media MNC capability centres in Bengaluru, verified from company contact/careers pages where they could be fetched (ExxonMobil, Novo Nordisk, Takeda, Carelon, Optum, Stryker, Halliburton careers, HCCB, Philips), lease and press coverage, developer occupier pages (Bagmane, Embassy REIT, ETV, BCIT) and OSM office POIs, with coordinates from OSM building footprints where a block was named and park centroids otherwise. The shared web-search budget ran out after two rounds, so the second half of the lens was worked from direct fetches of company and developer pages, the shared OSM extracts and the other lenses' files. CORRECTIONS TO THE BRIEF. Shell Technology Centre Bangalore is at Mahadeva Kodigehalli in the KIADB Hardware Park near the airport, not Mahadevapura; nothing places Shell at WTC Bengaluru. Halliburton's India technology centre is in Pune, but its Landmark software unit has a real Bengaluru office in Embassy TechVillage (Gardenia 2D and Hibiscus 2B). Chevron ENGINE is at RMZ Ecoworld, Bellandur, not Bagmane. Stryker, listed as Gurgaon-only, has a Bengaluru office at Sattva Knowledge Court. Siemens Healthineers is confirmed at Electronics City Phase 2 only; no source put it in a Bagmane park, and the location of its Rs 1,300 crore new campus (foundation stone March 2023) was not published in the sources read. Takeda's ICC opened January 2025, not 2024. CONFIRMED IN BENGALURU BUT LEFT OUT FOR WANT OF AN ADDRESS (presence is documented, no building or coordinates could be substantiated, and coordinates are never invented): Best Buy (Bengaluru tech hub, 350 staff growing to 500-550 per Aug 2025 coverage), Kimberly-Clark (Bengaluru digital/analytics hub), Evernorth/Cigna (Cigna Health Solutions India in Bengaluru since 2011, 1,600+), Bayer (Bengaluru captive since 2001, IT/digital farming/business services, ~1,100 tracked), Ingka Group Global Business Operations (only the IKEA Nagasandra store is placed), and Colgate-Palmolive (tracked profiles only). NOT CONFIRMED IN BENGALURU IN THIS RUN, SO OMITTED: SLB/Schlumberger (India technology centre is in Pune), BP (Pune), Saudi Aramco, Medtronic (Hyderabad engineering centre; only a dated Wikipedia ITPB tenant list names it), Boston Scientific and Zimmer Biomet (Pune), Abbott, Pfizer (Chennai/Mumbai), Merck/MSD (an OSM 'Merck' POI in Electronics City was not corroborated), Roche and Sanofi (Hyderabad), Johnson & Johnson, Humana, CVS, Albertsons, Kroger, Levi Strauss, lululemon, H&M, Sainsbury's, Ahold Delhaize, Costco (Hyderabad), Home Depot, P&G, Nestle (its Karnataka plant is in Nanjangud, Mysuru, outside the metro box), Mondelez, PepsiCo (Hyderabad GCC), L'Oreal and Sony Pictures Networks; each company's own locations page either 403'd, 404'd or named no Bengaluru site. LOW-CONFIDENCE ENTRIES, FLAGGED AS SUCH: Marks & Spencer, Reckitt and The Walt Disney Company rest on a single OSM office POI each; Victoria's Secret & Co. rests on the Mast Global Business Services POI at Manyata whose post-2021 parent (VS&Co vs Bath & Body Works) is ambiguous; AstraZeneca's Yelahanka plant is pinned to a locality geocode and is being exited; Oracle Health's Cedar C2 block comes from a pre-rename listing with a forum claim that Manyata leases were not renewed; GSK's Cunningham Road and Novo Nordisk's Featherlite addresses are directory-only. Philips' Manyata campus is recorded as closed (relocation completed early 2024). Optum's older 'Abacus Center, JP Nagar' listing and an OSM 'Coca Cola Bottling Plant' polygon near Old Madras Road were left out as unverified. DELIBERATELY SKIPPED AS OTHER LENSES' TERRITORY: Walmart, Target, Tesco and Lowe's (E01), Diageo and AB InBev (E06), Thomson Reuters and Bloomberg (E04); where they appear here it is only as park tenants.
